card.name: Partway through long unusual words
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle of a longer word that is split up, such as rec in recumbent, lic in millicuries, erc in Intercostal, and -C in SOLU-CORTEF. The next piece of the word is still to come.

modes.label: Split medical terms
modes.description: A middle piece of a medical term or brand name that is broken into several parts.

modes.label: Split ordinary words
modes.description: A middle piece of a less common general word such as receding or a Latin word.
